sensors: NIR spectrometer (2 detector variants for different spectral ranges)
key_facts.illumination: FLYING BEAM (scanned-zone-only illumination, energy savings up to 70 percent)

nodes.label_en: Acceleration/transport belt (troughed infeed belt with side walls, two drum pulleys, drive motors at infeed end)
Spectrometer scanner unit (NIR + VIS, orange beam spanning full belt width on a portal frame; optional EM sensor)
Control cabinet (receives detections, commands valve block)
Air valve block at the end of the belt (blows selected material)
Splitter roller (ejected material is lifted by air over it)
Separation chamber (housing at belt discharge with two bunkers)
Bunker for the air-ejected (sorted) fraction — far bunker, past the splitter roller
Lower transport belt or bunker for the non-ejected rest fraction — near bunker / lower belt

edges.label: belt passes under scanner; full width scanned linearly
fire command for the relevant valves
ejected fraction lifted over splitter roller into separation chamber
rest (not blown) falls on lower belt or into bunker
bunker is inside separation chamber (containment, not flow)
near bunker is inside separation chamber (containment, not flow)

physical_arrangement.render_description: Long flat troughed infeed belt with raised dark side walls on steel legs; two drive motors at infeed drum. Mid-length: steel portal/truss frame over the belt carrying a small orange electrical/switch cabinet (door with window) and the large orange TOMRA scanner bar spanning the full belt width with downward-facing sensor windows. A small operator panel sits on the belt rail under the scanner. At the discharge end: taller dark enclosed separation section with panels, piping/hoses on its side.
physical_arrangement.flow_direction: single straight line: infeed -> scan -> air ejection at belt end -> separation chamber with two side-by-side bunkers (near = rest, far = ejected fraction), both discharging downward/outward
physical_arrangement.floor_plan_link_unconfirmed: sorteerlijn 3 runs along the north side of Hal 7 into Hal 8; balenpers stands in Hal 8 near the line's east end (possible downstream of sorted fraction - ask operator)
